subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Tor Network
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Tor Network usable.

hook.text: The U.S. Navy built a tool to protect spies online. Now activists, journalists, and citizens use it too.

buildup.text: Tor routes internet traffic through multiple encrypted relays, hiding your location and identity.

discovery.text: Tor makes it nearly impossible for anyone — governments included — to trace your browsing.

twist.text: Tor also enables illegal marketplaces. The same tool that protects dissidents protects criminals.

climax.text: Tor forces a hard question: can you build privacy tools that protect everyone without protecting anyone?

punchline.text: Privacy for all means privacy for all. No exceptions.

quiz.question: Who originally developed the Tor network?
